content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for UPSC Specialist, Assistant Public Prosecutor & Law Officer Recruitment 2026 under Advt. No. 11/2026. Interested candidates can apply online from 12/09/2026 to 02/10/2026. Read the advertisement for age limit, syllabus, department-wise posts, selection procedure and pay scale.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)

UPSC Specialist, Assistant Public Prosecutor & Law Officer Recruitment 2026

UPSC Advt. No. 11/2026: Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 12/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 02/10/2026 up to 06 PM
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 02/10/2026
  • Exam Date: As per Schedule
  • Admit Card Available: Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: 25/-
  • SC / ST / PH: 0/-
  • All Category Female: 0/-

Pay the exam fee through online or offline fee mode only.

Age Limit Details

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 30-50 Years (Post Wise)

Age relaxation is applicable as per UPSC Specialist, Assistant Public Prosecutor and Law Officer Examination Rules, Advt. No. 11/2026.

Vacancy Details: Total 212 Posts

  • Assistant Public Prosecutor: 140 - Bachelor Degree in Law, 3 years experience at Bar, age limit 35 years.
  • Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine): 60 - MBBS with PG Degree in Medicine / General Medicine and 3 years teaching experience, age limit 40 years.
  • Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy): 04 - Master of Surgery in Anatomy / Medical Anatomy and 3 years teaching experience, age limit 40 years.
  • Assistant Editor: 02 - Bachelor Degree in Journalism or Mass Communication, or a related degree with diploma in Journalism or Mass Communication, and 3 years editing and publishing experience; maximum age 30 years.
  • Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) - Anaesthesiology: 01 - Medical postgraduate degree in Anaesthesiology or Diploma DA, with 3 years experience after PG Degree or 5 years after PG Diploma; age limit 50 years for ST only.
  • Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) - Pediatrics: 01 - Medical degree MD Paediatrics or PG Diploma DCH / PAED, with 3 years experience after PG Degree or 5 years after PG Diploma; age limit 45 years for EWS.
  • Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer / Law Officer: 04 - Bachelor Degree in Law, 2 years practice at Bar; age limit 40 years for ST only.

More eligibility details are available in the official notification.

How to Fill UPSC Online Form 2026

  • Apply online between 12/09/2026 and 02/10/2026.
  • Read the notification before applying for UPSC Latest Recruitment 2026.
  • Collect handwriting, eligibility, ID proof, address and basic details.
  • Keep scanned photograph, signature, thumb impression and supporting documents ready.
  • Check the preview and every column carefully before submitting.
  • Pay the required application fee to complete the form.
  • Take a printout of the final submitted form.
